scope: Original transported claims only; frozen D0 and FINAL grades/classifications unchanged. No repaired descriptors, expanded states, new detection claims or hidden D0 repair denominator.

definitions.strict_claim_match: Unchanged oracle match_claims: exact case/platform/state/requirement/expected/unit/status. P supports claim, F includes identity/expected/unit errors and concrete contradictions, U unavailable evidence.
definitions.strict_TP_FP_U: Among unique transported failure claims: raw matcher P=TP, F=FP, U=U. Identity/format rejection counts are shown separately from concrete product false alarms.
definitions.product_TP: Exact frozen matched failure claim P whose D0 row is in the sealed confirmed product F set.
definitions.product_FP: Concrete contradicted product-failure claim (for example exact descriptor, oracle P); not merely wrong expected/unit or unmapped scope.
definitions.product_U: No exact eligible identity/expected/unit match, immutable row U, or unresolved non-product attribution. A semantically compatible rejected descriptor gets no added detection credit.
definitions.detection: Unique exact matched confirmed product row IDs / sealed confirmed D0 product row count; cluster detected only when at least one such exact matched row belongs to its fixed_row_ids. Full manifestation coverage is reported separately.
definitions.repair: Public P1/P2 exact D0-to-FINAL row identities only. Confirmed D0 cluster resolved only if every applicable fixed_row_id is FINAL P.
definitions.non_failure: Original successful observations are retained separately and excluded from failure-claim FP/U denominators.
definitions.duplicates: Original typed-duplicate markers retained separately; no extra manual detection credit. Other exact duplicates are deduplicated by original descriptor/status without expansion.
definitions.classical_FPR: N/A: no complete negative/TN universe exists; conditional false discovery error FP/(TP+FP), bounds and denominators are reported.

metric_policy_note: Strict identity/format errors remain deterministic strict FP. Product-disposition uncertainty is separately reasoned, not an edit of strict metric definition or grant of semantic detection credit.

D0_confirmed_defect_clusters.description: On the existing mounted iOS component, caller replacement updates context/base/max but clears the available stove seed. Both public cases display 0 items / 1500 g and Choose shared equipment with disabled cover and confirmation instead of seeded stove, 1 item / 2300 g and Ready for departure. Same-process replacement and exact input binding are verified; .onChange/reset code is in production source. This is a single observed reset/seed defect manifested across two cases; the precise SwiftUI closure/state mechanism was not proven.

Rendered disabled SwiftUI buttons are additionally dimmed: disabled fill visibly becomes #E4EBE5 in light or #2B3E33 in dark rather than fixed #C9D7CC / #456251, with muted labels also dimmed. Original-state images independently show the discrepancy; source uses intended palette inside PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled. Numeric iOS native color cells remain U. This is one presentation defect repeated across states/cases.

cluster_resolutions.description: On the existing mounted iOS component, caller replacement updates context/base/max but clears the available stove seed. Both public cases display 0 items / 1500 g and Choose shared equipment with disabled cover and confirmation instead of seeded stove, 1 item / 2300 g and Ready for departure. Same-process replacement and exact input binding are verified; .onChange/reset code is in production source. This is a single observed reset/seed defect manifested across two cases; the precise SwiftUI closure/state mechanism was not proven.

cluster_resolutions.description: Rendered disabled SwiftUI buttons are additionally dimmed: disabled fill visibly becomes #E4EBE5 in light or #2B3E33 in dark rather than fixed #C9D7CC / #456251, with muted labels also dimmed. Original-state images independently show the discrepancy; source uses intended palette inside PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled. Numeric iOS native color cells remain U. This is one presentation defect repeated across states/cases.
